mapper.sql: a.id, COALESCE(r.shared_catalog_id, r.id) AS repository_id, a.name, a.category, a.description, COALESCE(canonical.name, r.name) AS catalog_name, a.create_time, a.input_format, a.output_format, a.gpu_required, a.is_system, a.catalog_seed, CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = #{tenant} THEN a.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = #{tenant} OR (a.catalog_seed = 1 AND a.image_url LIKE 'builtin://algorithm-covers/%') THEN a.image_url END AS image_url, CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = #{tenant} THEN a.pt_model_file_path END AS pt_model_file_path, CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = #{tenant} THEN a.onnx_model_file_path END AS onnx_model_file_path, CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = #{tenant} THEN a.config_params END AS config_params, (a.catalog_seed = 1 OR a.tenant_id <> #{tenant}) AS catalog_read_only

FROM vls_algorithm a JOIN vls_algorithm_repository r ON r.id = a.repository_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN vls_algorithm_repository canonical ON canonical.id = r.shared_catalog_id AND canonical.shared_catalog_id = canonical.id AND canonical.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (r.shared_catalog_id IS NULL AND a.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenant}) OR ( canonical.status = 1 AND (a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id OR r.id = canonical.id) AND (a.catalog_seed = 0 OR r.id = canonical.id) ) )
